title: Audience Targeting
meta: Audience research and a structured test across interests, lookalikes and custom lists. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Audience targeting, tested instead of guessed
overview: We work out who should see your ads and prove it with a small, fair test. We research your buyers, build several audiences in your ad account, such as interests, lookalikes of your best customers and custom lists you own, and run them side by side with equal budgets. At the end you get a plain table showing which audiences cost less per result, and which ones to stop.

pkgs.blurb: A research summary and three audiences ready to test.
Six audiences, a live test and a first results readout.
A full audience map with layered tests and a written playbook.

faq: Do I need an existing ad account with data?
It helps, because lookalikes need a source such as buyers or leads. If you have no data yet, we start with interest and search-intent audiences and build your own lists as you go.
Which platforms do you target on?
Meta, Google and TikTok are the usual choices. Tell us where you advertise, and we build for the platform that fits your buyers and your budget.
How long does a test need to run?
Usually one to two weeks with enough budget for each audience to get results. We set the test up within the delivery time and explain how to read it if it runs past our handover.
No. Platforms restrict targeting by health, finances, race and similar traits, and we follow those limits. We target by interest, behavior and your own opted-in lists only.
